notes.title: Jumpy 12.1 (Iroh Direct P2P networking!)
notes.content:
Important notes regarding online play:
- To connect to online, mathchmaker server should now be set to `lokmcpce2uzezmh2iq3vf23cbu3grzrct66qcpdfrizmcrrlk5uq`. Check settings, and press Reset on Networking tab to fix if not correct.

Known Issues:
- In online play, players may get hung on black screen during round transitions rarely. 
- A crash on connecting to online match has been observed but working on reproduction. If your game crashes in this situation (or any) please mention in discord or github - It may help us track it down. Thanks!

The cool stuff (Networking / Iroh):
Previously in online matches all players connecting to matchmaking server and relayed requests through it. This led to very high latency depending on player locations. We now use Iroh's awesome tech to connect players directly P2P (lower latency). In the case that a player cannot be directly connected to, a relay is used for only that player. Everyone should be connectable, but possibly HUGE improvements to latency for players who were previously not close to our server. 

Please give online a try with friends, nearby or across the globe, and let us know what the network experience is like. Thanks!

Checkout what else is new at change log:
https://github.com/fishfolk/jumpy/releases
